title: Grant
description: Claims of an agent grant: a short-lived JWT access token the STS issues for one task, bound to the sidecar's key and placed in the task's grant tree. It is a JWT access token in the sense of RFC 9068, sent with the header typ at+jwt, so ordinary OAuth resource servers can validate it. The agent's model never sees it.

iss.description: The STS that issued the grant.

sub.description: The user on whose behalf the agent acts, unique across every identity provider the box trusts. sub and act are kept separate.

sub_id.description: Where the user's identity came from: the identity provider and the subject it gave the user.

aud.description: Resource servers that accept the grant: exactly the locations of authorization_details.

client_id.description: The OAuth client the grant was issued to: the agent, as the identity it authenticated with names it, or its agent name for registration identities (RFC 9068).

scope.description: The operation names again, as OAuth scopes, for resource servers that read only scope. Never names an operation authorization_details does not.

auth_time.description: When the user signed in at the identity provider, from the identity token the task started with.

acr.description: How strongly the user signed in (OIDC acr), from the same identity token.

amr.description: Methods the user signed in with (RFC 8176), from the same identity token.

sid.description: The user's session at the identity provider. When the provider ends it, the STS revokes the task's grant tree.

act.description: The agent acting now; prior agents of a delegation chain are nested inside (RFC 8693 §4.1).

cnf.description: What the grant is bound to: a DPoP key (RFC 9449) or a TLS client certificate (RFC 8705), exactly one. Every grant from the box's own STS carries one; it is optional here only for clients that cannot hold a key, such as hosted agents run by a vendor.

jkt.description: JWK SHA-256 thumbprint of the DPoP key (RFC 7638), base64url.

x5t#S256.description: SHA-256 thumbprint of the client certificate, base64url.

task.description: The task this grant serves, as the initiating application declared it.

initiator.description: The application that started the task.

root.description: jti of the task's root grant; the root grant names itself. Revoking it revokes the whole tree, and every grant of one tree carries the same root, so a chain from another task cannot be spliced in.

parent.description: jti of the grant this one was narrowed from. Present exactly when depth > 0.

depth.description: Steps from the root grant: 0 for the root itself.

limits.description: Budgets this grant draws from, shared with the rest of the task's tree by name. A child repeats its parent's definition with a max no higher; the STS checks that when it issues the child.

status.description: Where to check revocation (Token Status List).

sub.description: The agent. Without iss, its agent name in this box; with iss, the identifier its own trust domain gives it.

iss.description: Trust domain of the actor, when it is not this box's own: an agent of a federated partner.
